Create stand input file for 3DCMCCFEM model

Source: R/make_inputs.R
make_stand.Rd

make_stand writes the site_stand.txt file from user-provided values, following the 3D-CMCC-FEM model specifications. Each element of the vectors is a row of the stand file, i.e., a class (species, age, DBH, height) in a given year.

Usage

make_stand(
  site,
  year,
  age,
  species,
  n_trees,
  avdbh,
  height,
  management = "T",
  x = 0,
  y = 0,
  stool = 0,
  wf = 0,
  wrc = 0,
  wrf = 0,
  ws = 0,
  wbb = 0,
  wres = 0,
  lai = -9999,
  species_dir = NULL,
  outdir
)

Arguments

site

Character: Name of the site. Used to construct output name

year

Integer vector: reference year(s) of the stand data. The first year must be the year_start of the simulation. More years can be used with man = "var" and pres_dens = "on".

age

Numeric vector: age of the class (years)

species

Character vector: species of the class. Must be the name of the parameterization file (without .txt), e.g. "Piceaabies"

n_trees

Numeric vector: number of trees in the cell

avdbh

Numeric vector: average DBH of the class (cm)

height

Numeric vector: average height of the class (m)

management

Character vector: "T" (timber) or "C" (coppice). Default to "T"

x, y

Numeric: cell position. Default to 0

stool

Numeric vector: number of stools (coppice). Default to 0

wf, wrc, wrf, ws, wbb, wres

Numeric vectors: initial biomass of foliage, coarse roots, fine roots, stem, branch and bark, reserves. Default to 0 (computed by the model)

lai

Numeric vector: LAI of the class. Default to -9999 (computed by the model)

species_dir

Character: optional path to the directory with the species parameterization files. If given, the existence of the files is checked

outdir

Character: path to the output directory.

Value

Invisibly, the stand data.frame. The file site_stand.txt is saved in outdir.

See also

run_3DCMCCFEM, virtual_stand_generator

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
make_stand("BilyKriz", year = 1997, age = 16, species = "Piceaabies",
           n_trees = 2408, avdbh = 7.11, height = 5.63, outdir = tempdir())
} # }
